workshops.title: Children’s Reading Session
workshops.description: A guided reading session adapted for children with specific needs, featuring visual support and a personalized pace.

workshops.title: Music Therapy Workshop
workshops.description: A music therapy workshop focused on cognitive and emotional development.

workshops.title: Fine Motor Skills
workshops.description: Fine motor and coordination activities through adapted games.

workshops.title: Musical Chairs Game
workshops.description: Goal: attention, coordination, and social interaction. Chairs in a circle (one less than participants). No one is eliminated.

workshops.title: Rhythm Imitation
workshops.description: Goal: auditory memory and coordination. The facilitator creates a rhythm, and the group repeats it.

workshops.title: Guided Dance
workshops.description: Goal: motor coordination. A leader performs movements, and the group imitates.

workshops.title: Name + Gesture Game
workshops.description: Goal: memory and interaction. Each person says their name and a gesture.

workshops.title: Ball Passing with Questions
workshops.description: Goal: communication. Pass the ball and answer questions.

workshops.title: Chain Story
workshops.description: Goal: creativity. Each person adds a sentence to build a story.

workshops.title: Image Association
workshops.description: Goal: comprehension. Associate images (e.g., animal → sound).

workshops.title: Simple Obstacle Course
workshops.description: Goal: motor skills. A course with tasks (walk, jump, navigate obstacles).

workshops.title: Throw and Catch Ball
workshops.description: Goal: coordination. Throw and catch the ball between participants.

workshops.title: Painting and Arts & Crafts
workshops.description: Goal: emotional expression, creativity, and fine motor skills. Painting, collage, or modeling activities.

excursions.title: Walk in Valongo
excursions.description: Gentle walk in a natural environment focused on sensory stimulation and group integration.

excursions.title: Outdoor Concert
excursions.description: Adapted concert for children sensitive to sound, with reduced volume and a quiet rest area.

excursions.title: Nature Walks
excursions.location: Parque da Cidade do Porto / Jardim do Palácio de Cristal
excursions.description: Short walk with stops to observe plants, animals, and natural sounds.

excursions.title: Aquarium Visit
excursions.description: Calm visit focused on selected animals to stimulate curiosity and visual attention.

excursions.title: Quiet Beach Day
excursions.description: Supervised free time for walking, playing in the sand, and sensory stimulation.

excursions.title: Educational Farm Visit
excursions.description: Interaction with animals and participation in simple daily farm activities.
